name: The Calling Station
tagline: Calls to see what happens. Raises only with three of a kind or better, and folds only when it's hopeless or its stack is at stake.

monster.desc: Three of a kind or better
monster.expr: made_hand = "three_of_a_kind" or made_hand = "straight" or made_hand = "flush" or made_hand = "full_house" or made_hand = "four_of_a_kind" or made_hand = "straight_flush"

hopeless.desc: Little chance of winning against a real bet, or a call that risks a fifth of the stack without an even chance
hopeless.expr: (equity < 0.25 and to_call > pot * 0.3) or (to_call >= stack * 0.2 and equity < 0.5)

table.why: Three of a kind or better: the one hand the Station raises with.
Nothing to call: check and see the next card.
Weak cards and more than four big blinds to call: too much, even for the Station.
The Station wants to see a flop.
Little chance of winning for what the call costs: fold.
The Station calls to see what happens.

raise_to.desc: The total bet when raising: the minimum raise
